THE LONG WAY ACROSS

A LITTLE STRUCTURE GOES A LONG WAY

Build something that holds.

01

Connect the banks

Select Road and click two points to connect them. Yellow anchors stay fixed. Keep the driving surface smooth from start to finish.

02

Think in triangles

Give the road a structure below or above it. Triangular supports keep a bridge from folding under the vehicle’s weight.

03

Choose your materials

Wood is economical for short spans. Steel carries heavier loads. Cables pull but cannot push, so they need something solid to hang from.

04

Put it to the test

Send the vehicle across and watch your bridge flex. Turn on Show stress to find overloaded beams, then return to building and strengthen them.

Spend wisely. Stay within the budget, use fewer materials, and aim for a clean crossing.
